announcements.t: Dabur India Limited has informed the Exchange about Upload of order passed by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, New Delhi Bench ("NCLT"), approving the Scheme of Amalgamation between Sesa Care Private Limited and Dabur India Limited under section 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013. |SUBJ
